phrases.text_l1: وإنه هن ما رح ياكلوا كل شي.
phrases.text_l2: and that they won't eat everything.

phrases.text_l1: بس أنا لازم أعمل، نحن بنحب نعمل
phrases.text_l2: But I have to make, we love to make

phrases.text_l1: كتير أكل، يعني لأنه نحن بنهتم،
phrases.text_l2: a lot of food, I mean because we care,
we care about the guest and we really love food.
And maybe when we are with a group

phrases.text_l1: أو لما نكون مع ناس كتير،
phrases.text_l2: or when we are with many people,

phrases.text_l1: بناكل أكتر، يعني ما بعرف ليش،
phrases.text_l2: we eat more, I mean, I don't know why,
we eat more.

phrases.text_l1: وآخر شي رح خبركن إنه نحن اللبنانية
phrases.text_l2: And the last thing I will tell you is that we Lebanese
really love life,
we love to dance, we love to sing,
we love music,
we sing in the car, we sing at home,
I mean, we love, we love life
and we love to live.
I mean, even in the war we were
living almost our lives
in a very normal way
and in a very natural way.
Why? Because we always I mean

phrases.text_l1: دايماً في شي بلبنان، دايماً في مشكلة،
phrases.text_l2: always there is something in Lebanon, always there is a problem,
always there is something happening,

phrases.text_l1: دايماً في مشكلة عم تصير من زمان.
phrases.text_l2: always there is a problem happening for a long time.
I mean, from our parents' days until now,
in our days also,

phrases.text_l1: دايماً في شي مش منيح عم يصير.
phrases.text_l2: always there is something bad happening.
So because of this we got used to,

phrases.text_l1: تعودنا ما نفكر بالأشياء المش منيحة،
phrases.text_l2: we got used to not thinking about the bad things,

phrases.text_l1: وتعودنا كمان نتقلم على كل شي، أوكي؟
phrases.text_l2: and we got used to also adapting to everything, okay?

phrases.text_l1: إي فهيدا كان كل شي تقريباً
phrases.text_l2: Yes, so this was almost everything
the good things at the Lebanese.
Tell me if you have any question,
Tell me if you learned

phrases.text_l1: شي جديد عن اللبنانية بهيدا الفيديو.
phrases.text_l2: something new about the Lebanese in this video.

phrases.text_l1: وقبل ما روح بدي قول ميرسي
phrases.text_l2: And before I go I want to say thanks

phrases.text_l1: لكل الأشخاص يلي عم يدعموني على Patreon،
phrases.text_l2: to all the people who are supporting me on Patreon,

phrases.text_l1: وبدي إلكن كمان ميرسي على تعليقاتكن
phrases.text_l2: And I want to say thanks to you also for your comments

phrases.text_l1: وعلى كل شي عم تكتبوا لي ياه.
phrases.text_l2: and for everything you write to me.
I hope your day is nice,
and I will see you in a new video.
Goodbye, bye.
